x²/a² - y²/b² = 1

The vertex is at (a, 0), so a = 8.

100/64 - 36/b² = 1
1.5625 - 36/b² = 1
36/b² = 0.5625

b = 8

So the hyperbola is x²/64 - y²/64 = 1, which means a = b = 8.
